DECLARE @JobId INT

SET @JobId = (SELECT JobId FROM EPSDTJob WHERE JobCode = 'SystemRefresh')

EXEC spCreateAppLog @JobId, 'JobRun', 'Refresh Language', 0, 0

TRUNCATE TABLE EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTLanguage

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT  	DISTINCT  	LANGUAGE_CD AS Code, 	LANGUAGE_DESC AS Description FROM REPORTING_REPOSITORY.dbo.MSTR_LANGUAGE

scripts.text:
UPDATE EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTLanguage
SET Used = 'Y' 
WHERE Code IN (SELECT DISTINCT Language FROM EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTCurrentMember)

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT  	DISTINCT 	MEMBER_LOOKUP.SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR AS MEMBER, 	ML.MBR_LANGUAGE_CD AS LANGUAGE	 FROM  REPORTING_REPOSITORY.dbo.MEMBER MEMBER (NOLOCK)  INNER JOIN REPORTING_REPOSITORY.dbo.MEMBER_LOOKUP MEMBER_LOOKUP (NOLOCK) ON MEMBER.MEMBER_ID = MEMBER_LOOKUP.MEMBER_ID INNER JOIN REPORTING_REPOSITORY..MEMBER_LANGUAGE ML (NOLOCK) ON MEMBER.MEMBER_ID = ML.MEMBER_ID  	AND ML.MBR_LANGUAGE_SEQ = 1  	AND ML.LOGICAL_DELETE_IND = 'N'

scripts.text:
UPDATE CM SET
	CM.Language = COALESCE(ML1.Language,ML2.Language,ML3.Language,NULL)
FROM EPSDTCurrentMember CM
LEFT JOIN EPSDTMemberLanguage ML1 ON ML1.Member = CM.Member AND ML1.Language = 'ENG'
LEFT JOIN EPSDTMemberLanguage ML2 ON ML2.Member = CM.Member AND ML2.Language = 'SPA'
LEFT JOIN EPSDTMemberLanguage ML3 ON ML3.Member = CM.Member 


UPDATE IM SET
	IM.Language = COALESCE(ML1.Language,ML2.Language,ML3.Language,NULL)
FROM EPSDTInactiveMember IM
LEFT JOIN EPSDTMemberLanguage ML1 ON ML1.Member = IM.Member AND ML1.Language = 'ENG'
LEFT JOIN EPSDTMemberLanguage ML2 ON ML2.Member = IM.Member AND ML2.Language = 'SPA'
LEFT JOIN EPSDTMemberLanguage ML3 ON ML3.Member = IM.Member
